problem: Kenji is climbing the stone stairs up to a mountain temple that has 4 bronze bells. He goes up 48 stairs, stops for a drink, then climbs another 29. From there, 17 stairs still separate him from the temple gate. What is the total number of stairs?
follow_up_questions: Coming back down, Kenji pauses once he has gone down 38 stairs. How many stairs are left beneath him?
He finishes the descent in 8 equal sections. How many stairs are in each section?

problem: How many steps lead to the top of the old city clock tower? Marta counted 48 steps before catching her breath, then 29 more, and saw that 17 were still above her. The clock has 4 faces.
follow_up_questions: Heading back down, she rested after 38 steps. What number of steps did she still have to go down?
If the rest of the way down was split into 8 equal flights, how many steps were in each flight?

problem: Mrs. Okafor ordered a big bag of rice for the school kitchen. The cooks used 26 kilograms of it on Tuesday and 18 kilograms on Wednesday. The kitchen windows were steamy all week. On Thursday morning, 33 kilograms were still in the bag. How much rice had Mrs. Okafor ordered?
follow_up_questions: During Thursday the cooks used 15 kilograms. How much rice was left by evening?
A parent donated 24 more kilograms. How much rice does the kitchen have now?
If the cooks use 7 kilograms every day, how many days will the rice last?

problem: What did the sack of bird seed at the city aviary weigh when Tavita carried it in? Keepers scooped out 26 kilograms for the parrots one week and 18 kilograms the next. A toucan squawked at every visitor. After that, the sack still held 33 kilograms.
follow_up_questions: The keepers then took 15 kilograms for the finches. How much seed stayed in the sack?
Tavita topped it up with 24 kilograms from a new delivery. What does the sack hold now?
The birds eat 7 kilograms a week. For how many weeks will this seed last?

problem: At the start of the mural project there were 60 liters of paint in a big drum. The 9 classes took turns painting, and when they were done the drum held 25 liters. What amount of paint did the classes use?
follow_up_questions: A second mural will need the same amount of paint. How many liters must be poured into the drum before it starts?

problem: How many liters of milk did the cheese makers use? Their steel vat started the morning at 60 liters, and after they made 9 wheels of cheese only 25 liters were left in it.
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow they will make the same batch again. How much milk must they add to the vat first?

problem: A box of 50 thumbtacks sat on Mr. Ruiz's desk. He used some to pin up posters, and 34 thumbtacks are still in the box. How many did he use?
follow_up_questions: He used the same number on each of 4 posters. How many thumbtacks held up each poster?
Later he pinned up 3 more posters with that many thumbtacks on each. How many thumbtacks are left in the box now?
A colleague handed him a new box of 25 thumbtacks. How many thumbtacks does Mr. Ruiz have now?

problem: How many beads did Amina take off her bead card to decorate hair clips, if the card began with 50 beads and now shows 34?
follow_up_questions: Each of 4 hair clips got the same number of beads. How many beads are on one clip?
She decorated 3 more clips, putting that same number on each. How many beads are on the card now?
Her grandmother then gave her another card with 25 beads. What is Amina's total number of beads now?

problem: A school soccer match was planned to last 45 minutes. When lightning was spotted, 18 minutes of play were still left. How many minutes had the teams played?
follow_up_questions: The players waited 20 minutes before the storm passed. How many minutes after kick-off did play start again?
Then they played the remaining minutes. How many minutes after kick-off did the match finish?

problem: A film at the community hall should run for 45 minutes. The power went out with 18 minutes still to go, so how many minutes of the film had already been shown?
follow_up_questions: The lights came back on 20 minutes later. Counting from the start of the film, after how many minutes did the power return?
The rest of the film was then shown. How many minutes after the start did it finish?

problem: After summer camp, Hana's suitcase weighed 9 kilograms. It was 4 kilograms lighter than when she arrived, since she had given away her books. What did the suitcase weigh on the first day of camp?
A delivery van dropped off 4 kilograms of bread at a cafe and now carries 9 kilograms. How many kilograms of bread were in the van when it left the bakery?
A rope for the school tug-of-war was 30 meters long. The teacher cut away a frayed end of 7 meters. What is the rope's length now?
follow_up_questions: Coach Ama ties it to another rope that is 12 meters long. How long is the rope after joining them?

problem: How long is Ravi's kite string after he snipped off a tangled section of 7 meters? Before that, it measured 30 meters.
follow_up_questions: He knots on a spare string of 12 meters. What is the total length of the string now?

problem: The movie on the long bus ride to grandma's house lasts 74 minutes. When Rashid looked at the screen, it said 26 minutes remaining. How many minutes of the movie had he watched?
'We will dock in 26 minutes,' the ferry captain announced. The whole crossing takes 74 minutes. For how long had the passengers been at sea?
Baker Nadia opened a 90-kilogram sack of flour. She used 34 kilograms for bread and later another 27 kilograms for buns. The shop smelled of warm butter. How much flour is left in the sack?
follow_up_questions: She bought another sack holding 45 kilograms. How much flour does she have now?
She packs all of it into small bags of 2 kilograms each. How many bags does she fill?
Customers buy 18 of the bags. How many bags are left?

problem: Find how many kilograms of sand are left in the pile at the playground. Workers started with 90 kilograms and spread 34 kilograms in the sandbox. Pigeons walked across the wet sand. After that, 27 kilograms went around the swings.
follow_up_questions: A truck dumped 45 more kilograms on the pile. How much sand is there now?
The workers shovel all of it into buckets, 2 kilograms per bucket. How many buckets do they fill?
They carry 18 buckets to the school garden. How many buckets are still at the playground?

problem: The museum gift shop had 83 postcards on its rack at opening time. The museum has 9 rooms of paintings. By closing, visitors had bought 56 postcards. How many postcards were still on the rack?
How many pumpkins remained at Farmer Olu's stand? He began Sunday with 83 pumpkins in 9 neat rows, and shoppers carried away 56 of them.
A school bus dropped off 23 children at the museum, and 34 children stayed on board. How many children had been on the bus?
follow_up_questions: At the next stop, 18 more children got off. How many are on the bus now?

problem: There are 34 boxes still on the delivery truck after the driver carried 23 boxes into the store. What was the number of boxes the truck had brought?
follow_up_questions: The driver then unloads 18 more boxes at a cafe. How many boxes remain on the truck?

problem: A motorboat started a fishing trip with 48 liters of fuel. Getting out to the island used 21 liters. How much fuel did it have for the return?
follow_up_questions: The ride home took just as much fuel as the ride out. How much fuel was in the boat at the end?

problem: What amount of water was left for the hike down? A scout troop carried 48 cups of water up the hill and drank 21 cups on the climb.
follow_up_questions: Going down, they drank the same amount as going up. How many cups were left at the bottom?

problem: Amelia is knitting a long scarf for winter. She knitted 23 rows on Saturday and 15 rows on Sunday, and she has 58 rows still to knit. How many rows will the scarf have?
follow_up_questions: She knits 26 rows on Monday. How many rows does she still have to knit?

problem: What is the total length of the hiking trail? Yusuf walked 23 kilometers on the first day and 15 kilometers on the second, and 58 kilometers of trail are still ahead of him.
follow_up_questions: He covers 26 kilometers on the third day. How many kilometers are left?

problem: A bag of birdseed in the school garden weighed 40 kilograms. After Ms. Kowalski filled the feeders, it weighed 25 kilograms. How much seed did she put in the feeders?
follow_up_questions: Later she filled the feeders with the same amount again. What does the bag weigh now?
She pours in 35 kilograms of new seed. What is the bag's weight then?

problem: How many kilograms of salt did the road crew spread on the icy street, if the bin on their truck went from 40 kilograms down to 25 kilograms?
follow_up_questions: The next night they spread just as much. How heavy is the load in the bin now?
The bin is refilled with 35 kilograms. What does it weigh after that?

problem: Before the class picnic, Omar packed 54 cookies to share. He came back with 29 cookies. The sun shone all afternoon. How many cookies did Omar share?
follow_up_questions: Each friend got 5 cookies. How many friends got cookies from Omar?

problem: At the end of the bake sale, Grace still had 29 of the 54 cupcakes she had baked. Her sign was painted bright pink. What number of cupcakes did she sell?
follow_up_questions: Every buyer took 5 cupcakes. How many buyers were there?

problem: The bike ride from our house to the lake takes 85 minutes altogether. Mom says there are 30 more minutes of riding ahead. How long have we been riding?
follow_up_questions: We take a 10-minute break and then ride the rest of the way. How many minutes after leaving home do we get to the lake?
Riding home takes 25 minutes less than riding to the lake. How long is the ride home?

problem: How long has the train been travelling? The whole journey to the coast takes 85 minutes, and the conductor just said we have 30 more minutes to go.
follow_up_questions: The train waits at a station for 10 minutes, then finishes the trip. How many minutes after departure do we reach the coast?
The trip back is 25 minutes shorter than the trip there. How many minutes does it take?

problem: A tablet's battery lasts for 50 minutes of video. Leon has watched 35 minutes of cartoons. For how many more minutes can he watch before the battery runs out?
follow_up_questions: Each cartoon episode is 5 minutes long. How many more episodes can he watch?
He wants to watch 7 more episodes. How many of them will have to wait until the tablet is charged?

problem: How many minutes of light are left? Grandpa lit a candle that burns for 50 minutes, then read stories by it for 35 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Each story takes 5 minutes to read. How many more stories can he read by candlelight?
The children want 7 more stories. How many of them will have to wait for a new candle?

problem: Mr. Patel drained 32 liters from the class fish tank to clean it, and 17 liters were left inside. How many liters had the tank held?
A juice cooler at sports day still holds 17 liters after the runners drank 32 liters. What amount of juice was in the cooler before?
A roll of paper for the school banner was 40 meters long. After 6 students cut sheets from it, 15 meters were left on the roll. How many meters of paper did the students cut?
follow_up_questions: The leftover paper was cut into 3 equal strips. How long was each strip?
The school then bought a new roll of 50 meters. How much longer is it than the old roll was at first?
The art club used 18 meters of the new roll for posters. How many meters of the new roll remain?

problem: How much fabric did the tailor's 6 helpers cut from a 40-meter bolt of cloth, if 15 meters were still on the bolt at the end of the day?
follow_up_questions: The tailor sewed the leftover cloth into 3 curtains of the same length. How many meters of cloth went into each curtain?
A new bolt of 50 meters arrived. By how many meters is it longer than the old bolt was?
The helpers cut 18 meters from the new bolt for tablecloths. How much is left on it?

problem: The race track at the school is 80 meters long. Fatima has run 36 meters when her shoelace comes undone. How far is she from the finish line?
follow_up_questions: She ties it and runs 25 meters more. How far does she still have to run?

problem: A swimmer is crossing a pond that is 80 meters wide. How many meters are left to swim after she has covered 36 meters?
follow_up_questions: After 25 more meters, how much farther does she have to swim?

problem: Mei put 18 cherries in a bowl on the porch. Birds pecked some away, and only 11 are left. How many cherries did the birds take?
follow_up_questions: Mei picks 9 more cherries from the tree. How many cherries are in the bowl now?

problem: Only 11 crayons are left in Daniel's box after his classmates borrowed some. If the box had 18 to begin with, how many crayons did they borrow?
follow_up_questions: His teacher adds 9 new crayons to the box. How many crayons does Daniel have in it now?

problem: A toy store had 70 teddy bears in 4 display windows when it opened. At closing time 38 teddy bears were left. How many were sold?
follow_up_questions: Half of the bears sold were brown. How many brown bears were sold?

problem: What number of loaves did the bakery sell today? It baked 70 loaves in its 4 ovens this morning, and 38 loaves were still on the shelves at closing.
follow_up_questions: Half of the loaves that were sold were rye bread. How many rye loaves were sold?

problem: Hamid put 25 photos into his new album. There are 36 photos left in the envelope. How many photos were in the envelope at the start?
Find how many seeds Lucia had at first. She planted 25 sunflower seeds in the garden and still has 36 in her packet.
A fisherman caught 83 kilograms of fish. He sold 36 kilograms at the harbor and gave 19 kilograms to his cousins. How many kilograms did he keep?
follow_up_questions: He packs the fish he kept into 4 boxes of equal weight. How heavy is each box?

problem: How many kilograms of apples did the orchard keep for itself? It picked 83 kilograms this autumn, gave 19 kilograms to the school and sold 36 kilograms to a juice factory.
follow_up_questions: The kept apples are split evenly into 4 baskets. What does each basket weigh?

problem: A school bus has 48 seats. Its fuel tank held 95 liters at the start of the month and 28 liters at the end. How many liters did the bus use that month?
follow_up_questions: The driver puts in 60 liters at the gas station. How much fuel is in the tank now?
The tank can hold up to 99 liters. How many more liters would fit?

problem: How much water did the 48 cows on the farm drink from the trough? In the morning it held 95 liters, and by evening only 28 liters.
follow_up_questions: Farmer Ines pumps in 60 liters. How much water is in the trough now?
The trough holds 99 liters when full. How much more water would fill it?

problem: Mina's bag held a total of 30 crackers for the school trip. She shared 12 crackers with her friends on the bus. How many crackers does she have left for herself?
follow_up_questions: She eats 3 crackers at each snack break. How many snack breaks will her crackers last?

problem: How many carrots does the zookeeper have left after feeding 12 to the hungry elephant? Her bucket held a total of 30 carrots.
follow_up_questions: She gives 3 carrots to each pony she passes. How many ponies can she feed with the rest?

problem: The pencil jar in the classroom had 36 pencils in the morning and only 14 by the afternoon. How many pencils were taken during the day?
follow_up_questions: The teacher puts 15 new pencils in the jar the next morning. How many pencils are in the jar now?

problem: When the bakery opened there were 36 bagels in the basket; at closing time just 14 were left. Work out how many bagels were sold.
follow_up_questions: The baker adds 15 fresh bagels the next morning. What is the number of bagels in the basket now?

problem: Ms. Lindqvist keeps a nature diary with 2 colored pens. She has written on 37 pages, and 24 pages are still blank. How many pages did the diary have when she bought it?
follow_up_questions: She writes 4 pages each week. In how many weeks will the diary be full?
Her next diary has 80 pages. How many more pages is that than the first diary?

problem: A photo album has 37 pages filled with pictures and 24 empty pages. Grandpa keeps it on a shelf with 2 other albums. How many pages does the album have in all?
follow_up_questions: Grandpa fills 4 pages a week. After how many weeks will the album be full?
A new album has 80 pages. By how many pages is it bigger than this one?

problem: Nobody weighed the clay bin before the weekend pottery classes began. Students at the 5 pottery wheels used 28 kilograms on Friday and 35 kilograms on Saturday, and on Sunday morning the bin held 19 kilograms. How much clay was in it at first?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday the class used 16 kilograms. How much clay was left after the weekend?
How many kilograms of clay did the students use over all three days?
Next month they plan to use 90 kilograms. How many more kilograms is that than this weekend?

problem: What was the weight of the sack of dog food at the animal shelter before the weekend? The shelter's 5 volunteers noted that the dogs ate 28 kilograms on Friday and 35 kilograms on Saturday, and that 19 kilograms remained on Sunday morning.
follow_up_questions: The dogs ate 16 kilograms on Sunday. How much food was left at the end of Sunday?
In total, how many kilograms did the dogs eat during the three days?
Next weekend the shelter expects the dogs to eat 90 kilograms. How much more is that than this weekend?

problem: There were 26 ducks on the pond at sunrise, along with 2 swans. By lunchtime some ducks had waddled off into the reeds, and only 9 were left on the water. How many ducks waddled off?
follow_up_questions: Later, 6 ducks from the reeds swam back onto the pond. How many ducks are on the pond now?
How many ducks are still in the reeds?
In the evening every duck was back on the pond, and 4 of them tucked their heads under their wings to sleep. How many ducks were still awake?

problem: How many students went out to the playground? Of the 26 students in the classroom, only 9 stayed inside to read when the bell rang. The 2 teachers stayed inside too.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 of the students on the playground came back in. How many students are in the classroom now?
How many students are still on the playground?
After the break every student was back inside, and 4 of them were sent to the library. How many students were not in the library?

problem: Our class rode in 3 buses on a field trip of 85 kilometers. At a rest stop, the driver said there were 38 kilometers still to go. How far had we traveled?
follow_up_questions: From the rest stop we drove 26 kilometers to a farm. How far was the farm from the end of the trip?

problem: How far had the 3 cyclists ridden? Their tour along the coast is 85 kilometers long, and the sign at the cafe said 38 kilometers remained.
follow_up_questions: After the cafe they rode 26 kilometers to a lighthouse. How many kilometers was the lighthouse from the finish?

problem: A hailstorm passed over the school garden. Before the storm the class had 48 sunflowers; afterwards only 31 were still standing. How many sunflowers did the storm knock down?
follow_up_questions: The class planted 12 new sunflowers. How many sunflowers do they have now?
How many fewer sunflowers do they have now than before the storm?
Each sunflower gives 3 handfuls of seeds. How many handfuls will the sunflowers give?

problem: How many goldfish did the pond lose over the hot summer? Leilani counted 48 goldfish in spring, but only 31 in August.
follow_up_questions: She bought 12 new goldfish. How many goldfish are in the pond now?
How many fewer goldfish are there now than in spring?
She gives each fish 3 food pellets. How many pellets does she need for all of them?

problem: The music box plays for 60 minutes after it is wound up. Sara has listened to it for 42 minutes. How many minutes of music are left?
follow_up_questions: She listens for 9 more minutes while drawing. How much music time is left now?

problem: How long can the flashlight on Bao's phone still shine? On the camping trip it can run for 60 minutes, and he has already used it for 42 minutes.
follow_up_questions: He uses it 9 more minutes to find the tent. How many minutes of light are left?

problem: Ms. Diaz filled a jug with juice for the class. The children drank 7 cups, and 5 cups were left. A paper kite hung on the classroom wall. How many cups of juice had she poured into the jug?
follow_up_questions: She poured in 8 more cups. How many cups are in the jug now?
The jug holds 15 cups when it is full. How many more cups would fill it?

problem: How many marbles had Ollie put in the jar before his friends took 7 to play with? Now 5 marbles are left in it. Ollie's jar has a red lid.
follow_up_questions: Ollie drops in 8 more marbles. How many marbles are in the jar now?
The jar is full with 15 marbles. How many more marbles can fit?

problem: The track around the school field is 95 meters long. Kemal jogged 38 meters, then walked 27 meters. How much of the lap was left?
follow_up_questions: He ran the rest of the lap and then ran 2 more whole laps. How many meters did he cover after walking?
How many meters did he move in all?

problem: How many meters of the lap were still ahead of the ice skater? The outer lap of the rink is 95 meters. Freya glided 38 meters and then skated slowly for 27 meters.
follow_up_questions: She raced to finish the lap and then skated 2 more full laps. How far did she skate after the slow part?
What was her total distance on the ice?

problem: Mr. Osei wrapped presents with ribbon from a 20-meter spool. Now only 8 meters are left on the spool. How much ribbon did he use?
follow_up_questions: He used the same length on each of 4 presents. How much ribbon went on each present?

problem: What length of fishing line did Grandpa Hemi use to mend his nets, if his reel held 20 meters and now has 8 meters left?
follow_up_questions: Each of 4 nets got the same length of line. How long was each piece?

problem: The class library shelf is 8 meters long and holds 64 books. Students borrow 27 books. How many books are still on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: Next week students borrow 15 more. How many books are left on the shelf then?

problem: How many carrots are still in the ground? A farmer's carrot row is 8 meters long with 64 carrots in it, and the rabbits dug up 27.
follow_up_questions: The following night they dig up 15 more. How many carrots remain?

problem: Hana's village is 52 kilometers from the campsite. She has cycled 34 kilometers of the way home. How many kilometers does she still have to cycle?
A train started 52 kilometers from the city and has traveled 34 kilometers toward it. What distance is left between the train and the city?
A shelf in the classroom is 93 centimeters long. Mr. Abebe put dictionaries on the first 28 centimeters and atlases on the next 36 centimeters. How much of the shelf is still empty?
follow_up_questions: He fills the empty part with storybooks and also fills another shelf 45 centimeters long with storybooks. How many centimeters of storybooks did he put up?

problem: How many centimeters of the art room wall are still bare? The wall is 93 centimeters wide; Yuki hung paintings across 28 centimeters and drawings across the next 36 centimeters.
follow_up_questions: She covers the bare part with photos and also covers a 45-centimeter board with photos. How many centimeters did the photos cover altogether?

problem: At the start of the school year, the class sticker book had 60 empty spaces. Now it has 23 empty spaces. Most of the stickers show dinosaurs. How many spaces have the children filled since the start of the year?
follow_up_questions: The teacher brings a second sticker book with 50 spaces. How many empty spaces do the two books have together?

problem: The parking garage at the mall had 60 empty spots when it opened this morning. Rain was drumming on the roof. Now only 23 spots are empty, so how many spots have cars filled?
follow_up_questions: A new level with 50 spots opens. How many empty spots are there now on all the levels?

problem: Over three days, the school cafeteria served 24 kilograms of pasta, then 19 kilograms, then 22 kilograms. After that, 31 kilograms of pasta were left in the storeroom. How many kilograms were in the storeroom at first?
follow_up_questions: On the fourth day the cafeteria served 26 kilograms. How much pasta was left?
A delivery brought 4 boxes with 15 kilograms in each. How much pasta is in the storeroom now?
If the cafeteria serves 13 kilograms each day, how many days will that last?

problem: The farm's hens ate 24 kilograms of feed on Monday, 19 kilograms on Tuesday and 22 kilograms on Wednesday, and the barrel still holds 31 kilograms. What did the barrel hold before Monday?
follow_up_questions: On Thursday the hens ate 26 kilograms. How much feed remained?
Farmer Bjorn then emptied 4 bags of 15 kilograms each into the barrel. How much feed is in it now?
The hens eat 13 kilograms a day. For how many days will the feed last?

problem: Rafael had 45 trading cards in all. After he added some to his cousin's collection, he had 18 left. How many cards did he add to his cousin's collection?
follow_up_questions: His cousin's collection already had 16 cards before that. How many does it have now?
How many more cards does his cousin have than Rafael now?

problem: How many shells did Noor add to her sister's jar if she collected 45 shells in all at the beach and has 18 left?
follow_up_questions: The jar already held 16 shells. How many shells are in it now?
How many more shells are in the jar than Noor has left?

problem: The class packed 96 hot dogs for the camping trip, more than they expected to eat. They ate 38 on the first night and 27 on the second night. How many hot dogs are left?
follow_up_questions: On the third day a parent brought 45 more hot dogs. How many hot dogs do they have now?
The class wants 90 hot dogs for the final party. How many more do they need?

problem: How much fuel is left in the fishing boat? The captain loaded 96 liters, more than he thought the trip needed, and the boat burned 38 liters on the first day and 27 liters on the second.
follow_up_questions: On the third day he bought 45 liters at a harbor. How many liters are on board now?
The captain wants 90 liters on board for the trip home. How many liters short is he?

problem: Checking the library shelf, the librarian found 47 books in place. The shelf held 64 books altogether when it was full. How many books are missing from the shelf?
follow_up_questions: Students returned 12 books to the shelf. How many books are on it now?
How many more books are needed to fill the shelf completely?

problem: How many fence posts did the winter storms knock down? The school garden fence had 64 posts altogether when it was new, and 47 are still standing.
follow_up_questions: Volunteers put 12 posts back up. How many posts are standing now?
How many more posts must go up for the fence to be complete?

problem: Leila baked 52 cookies, way more than her family could eat, so she gave 24 to her classmates. How many cookies does she have left?
The apple tree gave Mr. Sato 52 apples, far more than he needed. After handing 24 apples to the neighbors, how many does he still have?
Before the school photo, Aisha cut 15 centimeters off her hair. Her hair is now 27 centimeters long. The class sat in 6 rows for the photo. How long was her hair before the cut?
follow_up_questions: By summer her hair had grown 12 centimeters. How long is it now?
Aisha wants it 5 centimeters shorter than that. How long will it be after the next cut?

problem: How tall was the little hedge before the gardener trimmed it? She cut 15 centimeters off the top, and it is now 27 centimeters tall. The garden has 6 hedges.
follow_up_questions: Over the summer the hedge grew 12 centimeters. How tall is it now?
The gardener trims it so it is 5 centimeters shorter. What height will it be then?

problem: The school's rain barrel held 84 liters at the start of the week. Bright paintings covered its sides. By Friday, after the children watered the flower beds, 29 liters were left. How many liters had they used on the flowers?
follow_up_questions: A heavy rain then added 38 liters to the barrel. How much water does it hold now?

problem: How many liters of paint did the crew use on the old barn? They began with 84 liters in their buckets and had 29 liters left at the end. A rooster watched them from the roof.
follow_up_questions: The paint shop delivered 38 more liters. How much paint does the crew have now?

problem: The school hallway has 68 ceiling lights. A power surge burned out 15 of them. The janitor had a busy morning. How many lights still work?
How many seats in the cinema can still be used? The cinema has 68 seats, and a leaking roof ruined 15 of them. The smell of popcorn filled the room.
After the soccer game, the team drank 9 liters from the water cooler. Coach Ana checked and saw 6 liters still inside. How much water had been in the cooler?
follow_up_questions: She added 10 liters to the cooler. How much water is in it now?

problem: There are 6 liters of soup left in the pot after the campers ate 9 liters. How much soup did the pot hold before dinner?
follow_up_questions: The cook adds 10 liters of fresh soup. What amount is in the pot now?

problem: Mr. Lee poured 26 cups of lemonade from a big jug into bottles. There are 14 cups left in the jug. How many cups of lemonade did the jug hold at first?
follow_up_questions: Each bottle holds 2 cups. How many bottles did he fill?

problem: How many scoops of ice cream were in the tub before Ruth served 26 scoops into cones? There are still 14 scoops in the tub.
follow_up_questions: Each cone got 2 scoops. How many cones did she fill?

problem: Before washing the class's paintbrushes, Ms. Tran's bottle of soap held 90 milliliters. She used 24 milliliters on the big brushes and 31 milliliters on the small ones. How many milliliters of soap are left?
follow_up_questions: Washing one jar of brushes takes 5 milliliters. How many more jars can she wash with what is left?
She has 11 jars of brushes still to wash. For how many of them will she need new soap?

problem: How many grams of wax remain in the tin? Javier started with 90 grams of ski wax, rubbed 24 grams onto his skis and another 31 grams onto his snowboard.
follow_up_questions: Waxing one pair of skis needs 5 grams. How many more pairs can he wax with the rest?
His ski club has 11 pairs still to wax. For how many pairs will he need a new tin?

problem: Coach Sanchez brought a bag of 80 medals for sports day. The field had just been mowed. By the afternoon, 46 medals were still in the bag. How many medals had she handed out?
follow_up_questions: Each winner got 2 medals. How many winners were there?
There are 25 children on the team. How many of them have not won a medal yet?

problem: How many tickets has the ride operator at the fair torn off so far? His roll started with 80 tickets and now has 46. The Ferris wheel lights blinked red and gold.
follow_up_questions: Every rider gave 2 tickets. How many riders have there been?
A group of 25 children came to the fair today, and all the riders were from that group. How many of the children have not been on the ride yet?

problem: A suitcase on the airport scale weighed 45 kilograms. Planes roared outside the window. After Dad took out the heavy books, the scale read 28 kilograms. How many kilograms of books did he take out?
What weight of sand did the children unload? Their wagon weighed 45 kilograms when full, and after they emptied some into the sandbox it weighed 28 kilograms. A dog chased its tail nearby.
Kofi filled a cooler with 40 liters of iced tea for the school fair. The teachers drank 22 liters of it. How much iced tea is left?
follow_up_questions: The parents drink 11 liters. How many liters remain?

problem: How much paint is still in the bucket? Ms. Ito mixed 40 liters for the mural, and the wall used up 22 liters of it.
follow_up_questions: The fence takes 11 liters. How many liters are left now?

problem: Mr. Dube has been a bus driver for 25 years. His audiobook lasts 96 minutes, and he has listened to 47 minutes of it. How many minutes are still left to hear?
follow_up_questions: He listens to 16 minutes on each trip. After 2 trips, how many minutes will be left?

problem: For her 25th birthday Rosa got a jigsaw puzzle with 96 pieces. So far she has fitted 47 pieces. How many pieces are still not in place?
follow_up_questions: She fits 16 pieces each evening. After 2 evenings, how many pieces will still be loose?

problem: The pet shop sold 12 goldfish this morning, and 23 goldfish are still swimming in the tank. How many goldfish were in the tank before the shop opened?
There are 23 paper lanterns still hanging over the street after the wind blew 12 away. Find how many lanterns were hung at first.
The hallway in the new school is 48 meters long. On Monday, 4 workers laid carpet along 19 meters of it. How many meters still need carpet?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday they laid 13 meters more. How much is left to carpet?

problem: How many meters of the bike path still need to be paved? The path is 48 meters long, and a crew of 4 paved 19 meters this week.
follow_up_questions: Next week they pave another 13 meters. How much of the path is still unpaved?

problem: At sports day, runners added water to their bottles from a 60-liter tank until only 22 liters were left in it. How many liters did the runners take?
follow_up_questions: Each runner took 2 liters. How many runners filled bottles?
A coach refilled the tank with 30 liters. How many liters are in it now?
By the end of the day only 7 liters were left. How many liters were taken after the refill?

problem: How many scoops of popcorn did the movie club hand out? Kids added popcorn to their bags from a 60-scoop bin until just 22 scoops were left.
follow_up_questions: Every kid got 2 scoops. How many kids came for popcorn?
The club leader topped up the bin with 30 scoops. How many scoops are in it now?
At the end of the film only 7 scoops remained. How many scoops were handed out after the top-up?

problem: Joon-ho saved $34 for the science museum. He spent $21 on a rocket model in the gift shop. How much money does he have left?
What is left of Mariam's $34 after she pays $21 for a pair of roller skates?
At the start of summer, a beach shop had 85 sun hats on its racks. When summer ended, only 27 hats were left. How many sun hats were sold?
follow_up_questions: The shop orders 40 new hats for next summer. How many hats will it have once they arrive?

problem: How many pumpkins did Farmer Liu sell at the autumn market? He brought 85 pumpkins and drove home with 27.
follow_up_questions: He picks 40 more pumpkins from his field for next week. How many pumpkins will he have then?

problem: Some fans came to watch a school basketball game. At halftime, 18 fans went home, but 26 stayed to see the second half. The gym smelled of popcorn. How many fans were there at the start?
follow_up_questions: Late in the game, 9 of the fans who stayed had to leave. How many fans watched until the final whistle?

problem: How many children were at the library story hour when it began? At the snack break 18 children were picked up by their parents, while 26 stayed for the rest of the story. The librarian wore a dragon costume.
follow_up_questions: Near the end, 9 of the children who stayed were picked up too. How many heard the very last page?

problem: Hiroshi had $46 in his pocket. At the bookstore he paid $29 altogether for some comics and a pen. How much money is in his pocket now?
follow_up_questions: On the way home he buys a $5 sandwich for his friend. How much money is left?

problem: How much money remains in Sade's purse? It held $46 before she went to the hardware store, where she paid $29 altogether for paint and brushes.
follow_up_questions: Then she spends $5 on a bus ticket. How much is in her purse now?

problem: There were 32 goats on the hillside at Pedro's farm. Some of them trotted back to the shed, and now 14 goats are on the hillside. A hawk circled high above. How many goats went to the shed?
follow_up_questions: Pedro brushes 6 of the goats in the shed. How many goats in the shed are not being brushed?
Then 5 goats come down from the hillside and join the goats that are not being brushed. How many goats are in that group now?
How many goats are still on the hillside?

problem: How many children went inside to the art room? Of the 32 children in the schoolyard, only 14 are still outside after the rest went in to paint. The janitor was sweeping leaves.
follow_up_questions: The teacher gives 6 of the children in the art room clay instead of paint. How many children in the art room are painting?
Then 5 children come in from the yard and join the painters. How many children are painting now?
How many children are still out in the schoolyard?

problem: The class bake sale was raising money for a new fish tank. After paying $27 for flour and sugar, the class had $45 left. How much money did the bake sale bring in?
What did the scouts earn at their car wash, if they spent $27 of it on soap and buckets and $45 is left?
The drama club sold cookies to pay for costumes. It made $63, but $25 of that went on cookie dough. How much is left for the costumes?
follow_up_questions: A teacher gives the club $20 more. How much does it have for costumes now?

problem: How much money does the choir have left for its trip? It earned $63 at a concert and spent $25 on renting chairs.
follow_up_questions: A grandparent donates another $20. What amount does the choir have now?

problem: Ngozi took $92 to the music store. She bought a ukulele and a songbook and left with $37. How much did she spend altogether?
follow_up_questions: The ukulele cost $39. How much was the songbook?
Her friend buys the same songbook and pays with a $20 note. How much change does he get?
Ngozi spends $25 of her leftover money on a tuner. How much does she have now?

problem: How much did Sven spend altogether at the camping store? He went in with $92, bought a tent and a lantern, and came out with $37.
follow_up_questions: The tent was $39. What did the lantern cost?
His brother buys the same lantern with a $20 note. What change does he get back?
Sven then pays $25 of his remaining money for a sleeping mat. How much money does he have left?

problem: On a snowy morning some children were sledding down the hill. When lunch was called, 15 children went inside to eat, leaving 23 on the hill. The snow sparkled in the sun. How many children were sledding before lunch was called?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, 8 of the children who went inside came back out. How many children are on the hill now?
How many children are still inside?

problem: How many dancers were on the stage before the music stopped? When it stopped, 15 dancers stepped off to drink water and 23 stayed on stage. The curtains were dark blue.
follow_up_questions: When the music started again, 8 of the dancers who stepped off came back. How many dancers are on stage now?
How many dancers are still off the stage?

problem: Kofi had $81 when he went to the amusement park. Rides and snacks cost him $46. The roller coaster was painted green. How much money does he have now?
A trip to the planetarium cost Ilse $46 for a ticket and a snack. What is left of the $81 she brought? The show was all about the rings of Saturn.
Lucy had $50 when she arrived at the swimming pool. After paying for a season pass, she had $32. How much did the pass cost?
follow_up_questions: She then buys new goggles for $9. How much money does Lucy have now?

problem: What did the train ticket cost if Arjun's wallet held $50 before he bought it and $32 after?
follow_up_questions: On the train he buys a sandwich for $9. How much is in his wallet now?

problem: Mia's coin collection has 48 coins from 6 different countries. She gave 17 of the coins to her cousin. How many coins are in her collection now?
follow_up_questions: Her cousin gives her 9 old coins from Peru in return. How many coins does Mia have now?
If she puts 10 coins in each tray of her case, how many trays does she fill?

problem: How many marbles are left in Tariq's bag? It held 48 marbles in 6 colors, and he lost 17 of them in a game.
follow_up_questions: He wins 9 marbles back in the next game. How many marbles does he have now?
He sorts them into bags of 10. How many bags does he fill?

problem: At the start of the race, 36 toy boats were sailing on the pond. A sudden wind tipped some of them over. Now only 21 boats are still sailing. How many boats tipped over?
follow_up_questions: Children set 7 of the tipped boats upright again. How many boats are sailing now?
How many tipped boats are still lying on their sides?

problem: How many dominoes fell over when the cat bumped the table? Before that, 36 dominoes stood in a line; afterwards only 21 were still standing.
follow_up_questions: Ana stands 7 of the fallen dominoes back up. How many are standing now?
How many fallen dominoes are still lying down?

problem: The school's lemonade stand was open for 2 hours on sports day. From the money it collected, it paid $24 for lemons and sugar and had $35 left over. How much money did the stand collect?
How much money did the ice cream truck take in on Saturday? It parked by the beach for 2 hours, and after paying $24 for cones the driver still had $35 from the day's sales.
Uncle Mateus took $60 to the sports shop and bought a soccer ball for $35. How much money did he take home?
follow_up_questions: On the way home he stopped to buy a pump that cost $12. How much money is left?
Then he found $5 in his jacket pocket. What does he have now?
How much did he spend in all on the ball and the pump?

problem: How much was left of Ama's $60 after she bought a $35 dress at the market?
follow_up_questions: Next she bought a scarf for $12. How much money did she have then?
Her friend paid back $5 that she owed. How much money does Ama have now?
What did the dress and the scarf cost together?

problem: Ines keeps the money from her lemonade stand in a tin. The tin had $45 before she bought a new sign and $18 after. How much did the sign cost?
follow_up_questions: She also takes $9 from the tin for more cups. How much is in the tin now?
Sales on Saturday add $20 to the tin. How much does it hold now?

problem: What did the new bike lock cost, if Pavel's savings box held $45 before he bought it and $18 afterward?
follow_up_questions: He takes another $9 from the box for a bell. How much money is in it now?
His grandma puts $20 into the box. How much is in it then?

problem: The cook took away 14 plates from the stack to set the tables. That left 9 plates in the stack. How many plates were in the stack before?
follow_up_questions: The dishwasher adds 8 clean plates to the stack. How many plates are in it now?

problem: How many toy cars were in the box before Lena took away 14 of them to race on the floor? Now 9 cars are still in the box.
follow_up_questions: Her brother puts 8 more cars into the box. How many cars are in it now?

problem: The theater kept 52 seats for a school show. Classes filled 27 of those seats in all. How many of the kept seats are still empty?
follow_up_questions: The teachers sit in 10 of the empty seats. How many kept seats are empty now?

problem: How many raffle prizes does the fair still have? It started with 52 prizes, and winners collected 27 prizes in all.
follow_up_questions: The organizers give away 10 more prizes to helpers. How many prizes remain now?

problem: Ali put $41 in his wallet for a day at the water park. After paying for entry and a hot dog, he had $9 left to bring home. How much did the day at the water park cost him?
What did Freya spend at the book fair, if she arrived with $41 and went home with $9?
The gardener took 13 tulips out of a flower bed to give to a neighbor. Now the bed has fewer tulips: just 28. How many tulips were in the bed before?
How many books stood on the shelf before Mrs. Haddad moved 13 of them to her desk? The shelf now holds fewer books, only 28.
A skateboard Ella wanted was on sale for $46. She paid for it from her savings box, which held $91. How much is still in the box?
follow_up_questions: Her uncle puts $15 in the box for her birthday. How much is in the box now?

problem: How much remains in Omar's piggy bank after he takes out $46 for a telescope? The piggy bank had $91 in it.
follow_up_questions: His mom adds $15 to the piggy bank. What does it hold now?

problem: The chess club had $85 in its account. It bought new chess sets, and now the account shows $29. How much did the chess sets cost?
follow_up_questions: The club also has to pay $18 for a timer. What will the account show after that?

problem: What did the new soccer jerseys cost? The team's bank account dropped from $85 to $29 when it paid for them.
follow_up_questions: The team also pays $18 for socks. How much will be in the account then?

problem: After the concert in the gym, students stacked 24 chairs. That left 17 chairs still out, and 3 teachers stayed to stack those. How many chairs had been set out for the concert?
How many tents were at the campsite before 24 families packed up and left? Now 17 tents are still standing, and 3 of them are blue.
A haircut for Bruno came to a total of $14. He paid for it out of the $38 in his pocket. What money does he have left?
How much does Yasmin have left from her $38 once she pays the total of $14 for her pizza order?
Visitors took 19 maps from the stand at the zoo entrance, and 12 maps are still in the stand. How many maps were in the stand at first?
follow_up_questions: A zookeeper puts in 15 new maps. How many maps are in the stand now?
Before closing, 8 of the taken maps are brought back and put in the stand too. How many maps are in the stand now?

problem: How many paintbrushes were in the art room cup at the start of class? Students took 19 brushes for their pictures, and 12 brushes stayed in the cup.
follow_up_questions: The teacher adds 15 new brushes to the cup. How many brushes are in it now?
At the end of class, 8 of the brushes the students took are washed and put back. How many brushes are in the cup now?

problem: Hugo had $45 at the baseball game. His team won by 2 runs, and he celebrated by buying a cap for $18. How much money did he have after buying the cap?
How much money was left for Zainab after the concert? She came with $45, the band played 2 encores, and she bought a T-shirt for $18.
The school choir raised $95 at a spring concert. The audience clapped for a long time. Part of the money paid for a piano tuner, so $65 remains. How much did the piano tuner charge?
follow_up_questions: The choir then buys sheet music for $27. How much money is left?
A parent donates $40. How much does the choir have now?
New choir robes cost $90. How much more money does the choir need to buy them?

problem: What did the bus driver charge the hiking club? The club had $95 from a raffle, paid the driver, and now has $65 left. The raffle prize was a big basket of fruit.
follow_up_questions: The club spends $27 on trail maps. How much money remains?
A camping store gives the club $40. What does the club have now?
A new tent costs $90. How much more money is needed to buy it?

problem: Felix had $50 at the fair. He paid $12 for a ride pass and then $9 more for a bag of cotton candy. How much does Felix have left after buying both?
follow_up_questions: Then he buys a toy whistle for $7. How much money is left?
On the way out, his aunt gives him $10. How much does he have now?
How much did Felix spend at the fair altogether?

problem: How much of her $50 did Keiko still have at the aquarium after paying $12 to get in and $9 more for a shark book?
follow_up_questions: Next she bought a postcard set for $7. How much money was left?
Her father then gave her $10. How much does she have now?
What was the total that Keiko spent at the aquarium?

problem: The craft market had 12 stalls. Leo walked around them with $30 and bought a wooden yo-yo for $17. How much money did he have after that?
follow_up_questions: Next he buys a bracelet for $8. How much money does he have now?

problem: How much money did Noura have left after she bought a book of puzzles for $17? She had brought $30 to the book sale, which filled 12 rooms of the library.
follow_up_questions: She then buys a bookmark for $8. How much does she have left now?

problem: Ava went into the toy shop with $64 and came out with $26 and a stuffed giraffe that was 3 feet tall. What was the price of the giraffe?
follow_up_questions: A matching giraffe hat costs $19. If she buys it, how much money will she have?

problem: What did Dev pay for his new fishing rod? He had $64 when he entered the shop, and he left with a rod 3 meters long and $26 in his pocket.
follow_up_questions: A reel for the rod costs $19. How much money will he have left if he buys it?

problem: The art club spent $68 on paints and canvases for its winter show. After that, $47 remained in the club's money box. How much was in the money box before the art supplies were bought?
follow_up_questions: Selling paintings at the show adds $85 to the money box. How much is in it now?
The club pays $40 to rent the hall. How much is left?

problem: How much was in the band's savings before it bought new drumsticks and music stands for $68? The band now has $47 left.
follow_up_questions: A concert earns the band $85. How much money do they have now?
They pay $40 to repair a trumpet. What is left?

problem: Mrs. Ndlovu baked 36 muffins for the school bake sale. On the way there, 4 of them fell off the tray! How many muffins are left to sell?
How many balloons are still floating at the party? Dad blew up 36 balloons, but 4 of them popped on the rose bushes.

Mr. Novak's class has 28 students. On the museum trip, only 19 students were at the meeting point at lunchtime, because the rest were still in the gift shop. The museum had a dinosaur skeleton. How many students were still in the gift shop?
follow_up_questions: Mr. Novak fetched 5 of the students from the gift shop. How many are still there?
He brings the students he fetched to the meeting point. How many students are at the meeting point now?
Then a helper brings back all the students who were still in the shop. How many students are at the meeting point then?

problem: How many puppies had crawled under the porch, if only 19 of the 28 puppies at the shelter were in their pen this morning? The puppies were all spotted.
follow_up_questions: Volunteer Gabi pulled out 5 of the puppies from under the porch. How many are still under there?
She carries those puppies back to the pen. How many puppies are in the pen now?
Later the rest of the puppies crawl out and go back to the pen. How many puppies are in the pen then?

problem: Sami bought 2 kites at the beach shop. They cost him $15, and he went home with $18. How much money had he taken to the beach?
How much money did Ebony bring to the craft fair? She paid $15 for 2 clay bowls and had $18 left over.
The chess club raised $87 at a bake sale. It spent $49 of that money on clocks for its 6 newest members. How much of the bake sale money is left?
follow_up_questions: Next month the club raises $25 more at a book swap. How much money does it have now?

problem: How much of the $87 the swim team earned at its car wash is left after it paid $49 for kickboards? The team has 6 new swimmers this year.
follow_up_questions: A sponsor gives the team $25 more. How much money does the team have now?

problem: The picnic lasted 3 hours, and Mrs. Garcia brought 30 juice boxes. At the end, 12 juice boxes were still unopened. How many juice boxes did the children drink?
follow_up_questions: She gives 5 of the unopened boxes to a neighbor. How many unopened boxes does she have now?
For the next picnic she brings the unopened boxes plus 20 new ones. How many juice boxes does she bring?

problem: How many sandwiches were eaten on the 3-hour hiking trip? The leader packed 30 sandwiches, and 12 were still in the bag at the end.
follow_up_questions: He gives 5 of the leftover sandwiches to the park ranger. How many leftover sandwiches does he have now?
For the next trip he packs the leftovers plus 20 fresh sandwiches. How many sandwiches does he pack?

problem: After paying $13 for a camping flashlight, Pablo had $22 left in his wallet. The hardware store smelled of fresh wood. What did his wallet hold before he bought the flashlight?
follow_up_questions: He then pays $5 for batteries. How much is in his wallet now?

problem: How much money did Lena have before buying a $13 watering can at the garden center? She paid for it and found $22 still in her purse. Tiny tomato plants lined the shelves.
follow_up_questions: Then she pays $5 for a packet of seeds. How much is left in her purse?

problem: There were 72 people on the ferry deck. Then a tour group of 38 people went downstairs to the cafe. How many people stayed on the deck?
How many shoppers were left in the toy store after a class of 38 children went outside? Before that, 72 shoppers were in the store.
A scout troop raised $94 for a camping trip. Renting a cabin took part of it, and $56 is left for food. Find what the cabin cost.
follow_up_questions: The troop gives half of the money left to an animal shelter. How much does it give?

problem: What did the circus tickets cost the family? Their trip fund held $94, and after buying the tickets $56 was left for snacks.
follow_up_questions: They spend half of the snack money on popcorn. How much does the popcorn cost?

problem: The garden club kept $48 in its cash box. It spent $23 on a new rake. How much is in the cash box now?
follow_up_questions: The members put in $15 more. How much is in the cash box?
They buy flower seeds for $8. How much is left?
How much did the club spend on the rake and the seeds together?

problem: How much money is in the robotics team's envelope after they pay $23 for a motor? The envelope started with $48.
follow_up_questions: The team members add $15. What is in the envelope now?
Then they buy wires for $8. How much remains?
What did the motor and the wires cost in total?

problem: Kwabena took $80 to the county fair and spent some of it. When he got home, he counted $34 in his wallet. How much had he spent?
follow_up_questions: He spent $28 of it on a ride pass and the rest on food. How much did the food cost?
At home he adds $25 from his savings to his wallet. How much is in his wallet now?
How much more did the ride pass cost than the food?

problem: How much did Elif spend at the zoo, if she started the day with $80 and had $34 left in her bag at the end?
follow_up_questions: Of that, $28 went on a ticket and the rest on lunch. What did lunch cost?
Back home she puts $25 from her money box into her bag. What does her bag hold now?
By how much was the ticket more expensive than lunch?

problem: A haircut took $14 from Tomasz's pocket, and $9 is still in there. How much money did he have to begin with?
follow_up_questions: On the way home he buys gum for $3. How much is in his pocket now?

problem: Grace has $9 left in her purse after paying $14 at the museum entrance. What amount did she have before she paid?
follow_up_questions: In the museum cafe she buys a muffin for $3. How much money is in her purse now?

problem: The school library put 60 new bookmarks on the front desk on Monday. Rain tapped on the windows all day. By recess 35 bookmarks had been taken. How many bookmarks are still on the desk?
follow_up_questions: After lunch students take 18 more. How many are left when the library closes?

problem: How many tomato plants does the garden center still have? It started the weekend with 60 plants, and 35 were sold by Saturday noon. A cat slept between the flower pots.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday 18 more plants are sold. How many plants are left at the end of the weekend?

problem: Leaving for the bookstore, Naomi had $36 in her purse. Coming home with two new novels, she had only $11. How much did she spend at the bookstore?
What did Ravi pay at the pet shop if his wallet went from $36 to $11 after he bought fish food and a net?
The toy library lent out 21 board games over the holidays. There are 14 games still in the cupboard. How many board games did the toy library have before the holidays?
follow_up_questions: In January, 6 games are returned. How many games are in the cupboard then?

problem: How many tennis rackets did the sports center own at the start of the season? Members borrowed 21 rackets, and 14 are still on the rack.
follow_up_questions: At the end of the season 6 rackets are returned. How many rackets are on the rack now?

problem: There were 95 people on the beach at noon. When dark clouds came, 48 of them went into the cafe, so the beach had more empty space. How many people were still on the beach?
follow_up_questions: When the sun came out again, 26 people returned to the beach. How many people were on the beach then?
Each person who returned rented an umbrella for $2. How much did they pay for umbrellas?

problem: How many children were still on the playground after 48 of the 95 children went into the gym when it began to snow, leaving more room on the swings?
follow_up_questions: When the snow stopped, 26 children came back out. How many children were on the playground then?
Each child who came back out got 2 stickers from the teacher. How many stickers did the teacher hand out?

problem: The shop owner took $58 from the register to pay the window cleaner. That left $39 in the register. How much had the register held?
follow_up_questions: A customer then buys a lamp for $45. How much is in the register now?
The owner takes out $30 to buy light bulbs. How much is left?

problem: What amount was in the school's sports fund before the coach paid $58 for new hurdles? The fund now has $39.
follow_up_questions: Parents give $45 to the fund. How much does it hold now?
The coach spends $30 on a stopwatch. How much remains in the fund?

problem: In the park, a game of tag had 25 players until 7 of them were called home for dinner. How many children kept playing?
How many paper boats are still floating down the stream? Of the twenty-five boats the class launched, seven sank near the bridge.
A zookeeper put 40 crickets into the lizard's cage at 9 o'clock. Later there were 22 crickets left. How many crickets did the lizard eat?
follow_up_questions: The zookeeper adds 15 more crickets. How many crickets are in the cage now?
By night the lizard has eaten 20 of those. How many crickets are left?

problem: How many food pellets did the koi gobble up? At 9 o'clock the pond keeper dropped 40 pellets into the water, and an hour later 22 were still floating.
follow_up_questions: The keeper drops in 15 more pellets. How many pellets are floating now?
By evening the koi have eaten 20 of them. How many pellets are left?

problem: At closing time on Sunday, 29 key rings were left on the zoo shop's stand after 46 had been sold. Panda key rings were the favorite. How many key rings had been on the stand when the shop opened?
follow_up_questions: Each key ring cost $2. How much money did the shop take in for the ones it sold?
The shop orders 50 more key rings for the stand. How many will be on it then?

problem: How many cupcakes were on the bakery tray in the morning? By evening, customers had bought 46 cupcakes and 29 were still on the tray. The chocolate ones had sprinkles on top.
follow_up_questions: The cupcakes sold for $2 each. How much did the bakery earn from the ones it sold?
The baker adds 50 more cupcakes to the tray. How many are on it now?

problem: Lars had a pack of 20 balloons for his sister's party. He blew up 13 of them. How many balloons are still in the pack?
follow_up_questions: His aunt brings another pack of 20 balloons. How many unblown balloons does Lars have now?

problem: What number of stickers is left on Ms. Bello's sheet of 20 after she put 13 on her students' homework?
follow_up_questions: She opens another sheet of 20 stickers. How many stickers does she have now?

problem: Lucia had saved $33. She bought a paint set and a sketchbook and now has $8. In all, how much did she pay for the two things?
follow_up_questions: The paint set cost $19. What did the sketchbook cost?

problem: How much did the scooter helmet and the knee pads cost in all, if Mateus had $33 before buying them and $8 after?
follow_up_questions: The helmet was $19. How much were the knee pads?

problem: When the whistle blew, 8 players ran from the bench onto the field, while 11 players stayed on the bench to wait their turn. How many players had been sitting on the bench before the whistle?
follow_up_questions: In the second half, 5 more players run on from the bench. How many players are still on the bench?
How many players are on the field now?

problem: How many chicks were in the nest box before 8 of them hopped out into the yard? There are 11 chicks still inside the box.
follow_up_questions: Later, 5 more chicks hop out into the yard. How many chicks are still in the box?
How many chicks are in the yard now?

problem: A florist's change box held $35. Because the price of flowers went up, she had to take $12 out of the box to pay her supplier. How much money is in the box now?
follow_up_questions: Customers pay $9 more into the box. How much is in the box now?
The florist then takes out $20 for ribbons. How much is left?

problem: How much is left in the lemonade stand's money can? It held $35, but the price of lemons went up, so Jada took $12 out to buy more.
follow_up_questions: Then customers drop in $9. How much is in the can now?
Jada takes out $20 for cups and sugar. How much remains?

problem: Farmer Yusuf brought 85 melons to the fair on 4 carts. He drove home with 37 melons. How many melons did he sell?
follow_up_questions: He gives 12 of the leftover melons to his neighbors. How many melons are left?

problem: How many eggs were sold at the market stall? Mrs. Kim set out 85 eggs on 4 tables in the morning and packed up 37 at the end of the day.
follow_up_questions: She uses 12 of the leftover eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs remain?

problem: Selim paid a $4 late fee for a video game he rented, leaving him with $17. The game was about space pirates. How much money did Selim have before paying the fee?
follow_up_questions: He then buys a sticker for $2. How much money does he have left?

problem: How much was in Clara's purse before the parking fine? The fine was $4, and afterwards she had $17. The parking lot was next to a big park.
follow_up_questions: She then pays $2 for a bottle of water. How much does she have left?

problem: The chess tournament took in $78 from players and paid $49 for trophies. How much money does the tournament have left?
After the dance school spent $49 renting a hall, what was left of the $78 it had collected in class fees?
The Haddad family set aside $96 for a day at the water park. Entry cost them $64. The wave pool was very crowded. How much of the money was left?
follow_up_questions: They spend $18 on ice cream. How much is left now?

problem: How much of the $96 the Lopez family saved for the theme park was still unspent after paying $64 for entry? The roller coaster had a loop.
follow_up_questions: At the park they spend $18 on lunch. How much money is left?

problem: A park ranger had 50 badges to hand out on a nature walk. After the walk she had 13 left. How many badges did she hand out?
follow_up_questions: She gives 9 of the leftover badges to her nephews. How many does she have now?
The next day she gets a new box of 40 badges. How many badges does she have then?

problem: How many balloons did the clown give away at the fair if she started with 50 and has 13 left?
follow_up_questions: She gives 9 of the rest to her own kids. How many balloons does she have now?
Later she blows up 40 new balloons. How many balloons does she have then?

problem: A soccer team paid $45 for a van to the tournament, and its travel money is now down to $22. How much travel money did the team have before?
follow_up_questions: Tournament entry costs $18. How much travel money will be left after paying it?
Parents add $30 to the travel money. How much is there now?
How much did the team spend on the van and the entry in all?

problem: What was in the choir's trip fund at first, if hiring a coach cost $45 and the fund now holds $22?
follow_up_questions: Concert tickets for the choir cost $18. How much is left in the fund after paying for them?
A bake sale adds $30 to the fund. How much is in it now?
Together, how much did the choir spend on the coach and the tickets?

problem: Kaito's aunt gave him a tin of 64 seashells from a beach in Japan. He sent 27 of them to his cousin in Mexico. How many Japanese shells are left in the tin?
follow_up_questions: His cousin sends back 19 shells from Mexico, and Kaito puts them in the tin. How many shells does the tin hold now?
He lines them all up on a shelf in rows of 7. How many rows does he make?
His sister borrows 6 of the Mexican shells. How many Mexican shells does Kaito still have?

problem: How many postcards from Italy are still in Ana's album? Her grandmother filled it with 64 Italian postcards, and Ana gave 27 of them to her friend in Kenya.
follow_up_questions: Her friend sends back 19 postcards from Kenya, and Ana adds them to the album. How many postcards are in the album now?
Ana sorts them all into piles of 7. How many piles does she make?
Her cousin borrows 6 of the Kenyan postcards. How many Kenyan postcards does Ana still have?

problem: Mr. Kim's class made 30 paper airplanes for the contest. Some got crumpled, and the class added those to the recycling box. Now only 12 planes can still fly. How many planes got crumpled?
follow_up_questions: The class folds 10 new planes. How many planes can fly now?

problem: How many sandcastles did the waves knock down? The children built 30 sandcastles and added a flag to each, but by noon only 12 were still standing.
follow_up_questions: They build 10 new sandcastles. How many are standing now?

problem: Kwame has $14 left after buying a $6 poster at the concert. How much money did he have before?
follow_up_questions: During the break he buys two bottles of water for $3 each. How much money is left?
His uncle gives him $10 for the taxi home. How much does he have now?

problem: At the zoo, Lina paid $6 for a map and still had $14 in her pocket. What did she have before buying the map?
follow_up_questions: She then buys 2 ice pops at $3 each. How much money does she have left?
Her grandpa gives her $10. How much money does Lina have now?

problem: A farm stand had 96 ears of corn in the morning. A grocery store bought 45 of them, and a restaurant bought 28. How many ears of corn were left?
follow_up_questions: The farmer sells the leftover corn at $2 an ear. How much money does he get?
He spends $15 of that on seeds. How much of it is left?

problem: How many cupcakes were left at the end of the bake sale? The class started with 96, a teacher bought 45 for a staff party, and the soccer team bought 28.
follow_up_questions: The class sells the leftover cupcakes for $2 each. How much money do they get?
They spend $15 of that money on a gift for the principal. How much is left?

problem: The class party money was $93 at the start of the month. After buying balloons and a cake, only $45 is left. How much did the class spend on the party altogether?
follow_up_questions: The balloons cost $29. How much was the cake?

problem: How much did the zoo spend altogether on fish and fruit for the animals this week, if its food budget dropped from $93 to $45?
follow_up_questions: The fish cost $29. What did the fruit cost?

problem: There were 45 chairs set up in the school hall. The janitor carried 20 of them to the music room. How many chairs are still in the hall?
follow_up_questions: Then the drama class stacks away 6 of the chairs in the hall. How many chairs are still set up?
The janitor brings back the chairs from the music room and sets them up in the hall. How many chairs are set up now?

problem: How many tents are still up at the scout camp? There were 45 tents on the field, and the scouts took down 20 of them to dry.
follow_up_questions: Then a strong wind blows down 6 of the tents that are still up. How many tents are standing?
The scouts put the dried tents back up. How many tents are standing now?

problem: Priya took $70 to the school fair and bought a toy robot and a board game. The face painting line was very long. She came home with $26. How much did the robot and the game cost together?
follow_up_questions: The robot cost $12. What did the board game cost?

problem: What did Malia spend on a tent and a sleeping bag? She went into the camping store with $70 and came out with $26. A stuffed bear stood by the door.
follow_up_questions: The sleeping bag cost $12. How much was the tent?

problem: Children took 17 hula hoops from the gym cart. Only 8 hoops were left on it. How many hoops had been on the cart?
follow_up_questions: Later 9 children put their hoops back. How many hoops are on the cart now?
How many hoops are still being used?

problem: How many umbrellas were in the stand by the school door before 17 students took one each? Now 8 umbrellas are left in the stand.
follow_up_questions: When the rain stops, 9 students bring their umbrellas back. How many umbrellas are in the stand now?
How many umbrellas are still out with students?

problem: The goat keeper's bucket had 33 carrots. The goats munched 21 of them in the morning. How many carrots are still in the bucket?
follow_up_questions: The keeper brings 18 more carrots. How many carrots are in the bucket now?
In the afternoon the goats munch 14 more. How many carrots are left?
How many carrots did the goats eat that day in total?

problem: What number of cookies is still in the jar? It held 33 cookies before the cousins visited, and they ate 21 of them.
follow_up_questions: Grandma bakes 18 more cookies for the jar. How many cookies are in it now?
At bedtime the cousins eat 14 more. How many cookies are left?
How many cookies did the cousins eat that day altogether?

problem: Ji-woo's $28 turned into $11 when she bought a puzzle at the toy store. The store had a toy train running around the ceiling. How much did the puzzle cost?
follow_up_questions: She buys a bouncy ball for $7. How much money does she have now?

problem: How much was the dinosaur model Kai bought at the museum shop? He had $28 before and $11 after. The museum floor was made of shiny marble.
follow_up_questions: Then he buys a fossil keyring for $7. How much money does he have left?

problem: On the way to the fair, Bilal lost $5 through a hole in his pocket. Now he has $16. How much money did he have when he set out?
follow_up_questions: He spends $9 on a ride ticket. How much does he have left?

problem: How much money was in Chiara's coat before she lost $5 at the park? There is $16 in it now.
follow_up_questions: She pays $9 for a boat ride on the lake. How much money is left?

problem: Amaru had $40. He spent $24 on art supplies for his comic book. How much money does he have left?
follow_up_questions: His aunt sends him $15. How much money does he have now?
He spends $9 on a drawing pad. How much money is left?

problem: After paying $24 at the craft store for yarn, what is left of Sienna's $40?
follow_up_questions: Her neighbor pays her $15 for walking the dog. How much does she have now?
She buys knitting needles for $9. How much money remains?

problem: A hose reel held 92 meters of hose. The firefighter pulled out hose until 47 meters were left on the reel. How many meters of hose did she pull out?
follow_up_questions: She then winds 20 meters back onto the reel. How many meters are on the reel now?
How many meters of hose are still pulled out?

problem: How many meters of fishing line has Tama let out if his reel held 92 meters and now holds 47?
follow_up_questions: He reels in 20 meters. How much line is on the reel now?
How many meters of line are still out in the water?

problem: The cinema gave $75 back to customers when the projector broke. After that, its cash drawer still held $88. How much was in the cash drawer before the refunds?
How much money was in the concert hall's ticket office before it refunded $75 for a cancelled concert? Afterwards it still had $88.
Mr. Alvarez's flower shop had $64 in the till in the morning. He paid $38 for roses, which came in 3 big buckets. How much money is in the till now?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon he sells bouquets for $45. How much is in the till now?
He pays his helper $30. How much is left in the till?

problem: How much money is left in the cafe's cash box after the owner pays $38 for coffee beans delivered in 3 bags? The box held $64 at noon.
follow_up_questions: Afternoon customers pay $45 for drinks. How much is in the cash box now?
The owner pays the cleaner $30. How much remains in the box?

problem: A raccoon raided the campers' bag of marshmallows during the night. In the evening there were 26 marshmallows; by morning only 17 were left. How many did the raccoon eat?
follow_up_questions: The campers buy 12 more marshmallows and put them in the bag. How many marshmallows are in the bag now?

problem: How many cookies did the puppy eat? There were 26 cookies on the plate before Max the puppy jumped on the table, and only 17 afterwards.
follow_up_questions: Dad bakes 12 more cookies and puts them on the plate. How many cookies are on the plate now?

problem: A pack of name tags was opened at the start of camp week. By the last day, the camp leader had given out 38 tags, and 19 tags were still in the pack. How many tags were in the pack at the start?
follow_up_questions: She gets a new pack of 25 tags and adds them. How many tags does she have now?
The next week she gives out 30 tags. How many are left?

problem: How many raffle tickets were on the roll on Monday morning? By Friday the school office had sold 38 tickets, and 19 were still on the roll.
follow_up_questions: The office adds a strip of 25 more tickets to the roll. How many tickets are on the roll now?
The following week it sells 30 tickets. How many are left?

problem: Grandpa gave Soraya $33 to spend at the summer fair. By noon she had spent $12 on a ride and popcorn. How much of her fair money does she still have?
follow_up_questions: Then she buys a lemonade for $4. How much money is left?

problem: How much pocket money does Erik have left for the ski trip? He started with $33 and has used $12 on hot chocolate and a hat.
follow_up_questions: Next he spends $4 on a postcard. How much does he have left?

problem: The concert hall had 98 people in the audience. During the last song, many left early to catch their trains, and 59 people were still there when the music ended. The singer wore a silver jacket. How many people left early?
follow_up_questions: After the show, 24 of the people who stayed lined up to meet the singer. How many of them did not line up?

problem: How many runners dropped out of the fun run? It started with 98 runners, and 59 crossed the finish line. Balloons decorated the finish arch.
follow_up_questions: Of the runners who finished, 24 took a free water bottle. How many finishers did not take one?

problem: Hugo put some money in his backpack for the field trip. After spending $8 at the museum cafe, he had $12 left in it. How much had he put in the backpack?
follow_up_questions: The next day he pays $6 for a bus ticket. How much is left in the backpack?
His dad adds $10 to the backpack. How much is in it now?
How much did Hugo spend over the two days?

problem: What amount did Yara bring in her pencil case, if she spent $8 at the school book fair and has $12 left?
follow_up_questions: On the second day she pays $6 for a poster. How much money is left?
Her teacher gives her a $10 prize for reading. How much does she have now?
How much did Yara spend on the two days in total?

problem: There were 44 children on the soccer field at recess. When it got cold, 25 of them ran inside to join their friends in the gym. How many children stayed on the field?
follow_up_questions: Later 9 of the children who went inside came back out to the field. How many children are on the field now?
How many of the children who went inside are still in the gym?
The teacher gives 2 stickers to each child on the field. How many stickers does she give out?

problem: How many seals were still lying on the beach after 25 of the 44 seals slid into the sea to join the others swimming there?
follow_up_questions: Later 9 of the seals that went into the sea came back onto the beach. How many seals are on the beach now?
How many of the seals that slid into the sea are still swimming?
A scientist puts 2 tags on each seal on the beach. How many tags does she use?

problem: Ayo paid for a bowling game with a $20 note and got $6 back in change. How much did the bowling game cost?
follow_up_questions: He spends his change on a pair of socks and has $2 left. How much were the socks?

problem: What did the boat ride cost? Lina gave the captain a $20 note, and he handed her $6 in change.
follow_up_questions: With the change she buys a seashell necklace, and $2 is left. How much was the necklace?

problem: There was a long line for the roller coaster. The first car took 12 children, which left 15 still in line. The roller coaster track was 9 meters high. How many children were in line at first?
follow_up_questions: The next car takes 10 more children. How many are still waiting?
How many children have gone on the ride so far?

problem: How many people were waiting for the elevator in the lobby? It carried 12 people up to the top floor, leaving 15 still waiting. The building has 9 floors.
follow_up_questions: The elevator comes back and takes 10 more people. How many are still waiting?
How many people has the elevator taken up so far?

problem: At the spring fair, the garden club sold 32 of the 50 seed packets it brought. How many packets did it take home?
follow_up_questions: Each packet sold for $2. How much money did the club raise?

problem: How many cookies did Mr. Tanaka's class not sell? They baked 50 cookies for the school fair, and 32 were bought.
follow_up_questions: The cookies were $2 each. What did the class earn from the ones that were bought?

problem: Before the big game, the players took 16 basketballs off the rack. The rack still holds 9 balls. How many basketballs were on the rack before the game?
follow_up_questions: After the game, 12 balls are put back. How many balls are on the rack now?
How many balls are still with the players?
The coach buys 6 new balls for the rack. How many balls are on it now?

problem: How many library books were on the trolley before the students borrowed 16 of them for their projects? Now there are 9 books on it.
follow_up_questions: The next day, 12 books are returned to the trolley. How many books are on it now?
How many books do the students still have?
The librarian adds 6 new books to the trolley. How many books are on it now?
