problem: On Sunday afternoon, 46 children were skating at the ice rink. If 18 of them left the ice for hot chocolate, how many children were still skating?
follow_up_questions: After the break, 9 of the children who had left went back on the ice. How many children were skating then?
At closing time the staff asked everyone off the ice except 5 hockey players. How many children left the ice at closing time?

problem: How many kids were still in the bounce house after 18 of the 46 kids climbed out for pizza at the party?
follow_up_questions: After the pizza, 9 of the kids who climbed out went back in. How many kids were bouncing then?
Later the parents called everyone out except 5 small kids. How many kids came out at that time?

problem: The knitting club took some yarn from the craft room basket for scarves. On Monday morning the basket held 54 balls of yarn, and on Tuesday morning it held 30. How many balls did the club take?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday the club took 12 more balls for hats. What number of balls is left in the basket now?
Counting both days, how many balls of yarn has the club taken?

problem: How many potatoes did the soup kitchen use? The sack had 54 potatoes when the week began and 30 after the first big pot of soup.
follow_up_questions: Then the cooks took 12 more potatoes for a second pot. How many potatoes are left in the sack?
In total, how many potatoes have the cooks taken from the sack?

problem: During the 20-minute bus ride home from the market, Tomas ate 7 grapes from his bag. When he got home, 26 grapes were left. How many grapes were in the bag when he got on the bus?
follow_up_questions: His dad used 14 of the remaining grapes in a fruit salad. How many grapes did that leave?
Tomas gave half of the rest to his sister. How many grapes did his sister get?

problem: How many strawberries were in Amira's box before her 20-minute walk from the farm? On the way she ate 7, and at home 26 were left.
follow_up_questions: Her grandmother used 14 of the strawberries to make jam. How many strawberries were left after that?
Amira shared half of them with her friend. How many did her friend get?

problem: A ferry left the harbor with 84 passengers. At the first island 27 people got off, and at the second island another 19 left. No one came aboard. How many passengers were on the ferry after the second island?
How many tourists were still on the sightseeing bus after its second stop? It set off with 84 tourists, 27 got off at the castle, then 19 more got off at the museum, and nobody got on.
Coach Patel counted 30 tennis balls in the storage room on Monday. By Friday there were only 22, because some had been lent to the junior team. How many balls were lent?
follow_up_questions: The next Monday the junior team returned 5 balls. How many balls are in the storage room now?

problem: What number of microscopes did the science lab lend to another school, if it had 30 at the start of the month and 22 at the end?
follow_up_questions: The other school sends back 5 microscopes. How many does the lab have now?

problem: During a 3-day sleepover, the cousins ate 16 pancakes from the freezer. On the last day, 9 pancakes were left for breakfast. How many pancakes were in the freezer when the sleepover began?
follow_up_questions: Aunt Rosa made 12 more pancakes and put them in the freezer. How many pancakes are in the freezer now?

problem: How many sandbags were by the river before the 3 workers piled 16 of them along the bank? Now there are 9 bags left.
follow_up_questions: A truck drops off 12 more bags. How many bags are there now?

problem: A tram has 52 seats. On Saturday morning 38 people got on at the first station, and at the next stop 15 people stepped off. How many people stayed on the tram?
follow_up_questions: At the market stop, 6 more people got off. How many people were still on the tram?

problem: How many hikers kept walking to the summit? A group of 38 hikers started up the trail, which has 52 trail markers, and 15 of them turned back at the waterfall.
follow_up_questions: Near the top, 6 more hikers turned back. How many hikers were still climbing?
